units.source_text: “那个年代还没有什么‘觉醒’啦、‘新生活’啦之类的新词儿。

en.t: In those days, there were not yet any new terms like 'awakening' or 'new life'.

units.source_text: 不过，K之所以无法毅然决然地抛弃旧我，不顾一切地奔向新的目标，

en.t: But the reason K could not resolutely cast off his old self and rush headlong toward a new goal

units.source_text: 并非因为他缺乏现代人的观念，而是因为他有着不能够轻易抛弃的可贵经历。

en.t: was not that he lacked modern ideas, but that he had precious experiences he could not easily abandon.

units.source_text: 也可以说，他是因此而活到今天的。

en.t: You could even say that he had lived up to this day because of them.

units.source_text: 所以，即便他没有一往无前地冲向自己所爱的目标，

en.t: Therefore, even if he did not charge straight toward the object of his love,

units.source_text: 也绝不能说明他爱得不够深，无论怎样激情燃烧，他也不会放任行事的。

en.t: that by no means proved that his love was shallow; however fiercely his passion burned, he would not act recklessly.

units.source_text: 只要没有足以使他丧失理智、冲动妄为的契机，

en.t: So long as there was no occasion powerful enough to make him lose his reason and act on impulse,

units.source_text: 他就不能不停下来，回顾一下自己的过去。

en.t: he could not help stopping for a moment and looking back on his own past.

units.source_text: 如此一来，他就势必沿着以前所走过的路继续走下去，

en.t: Once he did that, he was bound to keep following the road he had already taken before,

units.source_text: 而且，他具有现代人所不具备的倔强和隐忍的性格。

en.t: and besides, he possessed a stubbornness and endurance that modern people do not have.

units.source_text: 我自信在这两点上，都已经看透了他的心。

en.t: I was confident that, on both of these points, I had seen through his heart.

units.source_text: 从上野回来的那晚，我倒是睡得比较安稳。

en.t: The night we came back from Ueno, I slept rather peacefully.

units.source_text: K离席后，我紧跟着他回了屋，坐在他的桌旁，

en.t: After K left the room, I followed close behind him to his room and sat down by his desk,

units.source_text: 然后故意跟他东拉西扯地闲聊，他露出很烦的神色。

en.t: then deliberately chatted with him about this and that; he looked quite annoyed.

units.source_text: 我的眼睛里很可能闪烁着胜利之光，所以声音听起来也肯定是洋洋自得的。

en.t: There was probably a gleam of victory in my eyes, and my voice must certainly have sounded triumphant.

units.source_text: 在K的火盆旁烤了一会儿手之后，我就回到了自己的房间。

en.t: After warming my hands for a while beside K's brazier, I returned to my own room.

units.source_text: 尽管无论哪方面，我都不及他，但只有那时，

en.t: Although I was inferior to him in every respect, at that moment alone,

units.source_text: 我觉得对他是不必惧怕的。

en.t: I felt that I had no need to fear him.
